<thought>This is a bring-6-pick-3 singles format, so I want a core with strong type synergy, speed control, and flexible lead options. Garchomp and Dragonite provide offensive pressure, Rotom-Wash offers pivot/ground immunity, Gholdengo is a bulky special attacker that blanks common Fighting/Normal moves, Annihilape punishes passive play, and Tinkaton provides Fairy/Steel utility with Knock Off and Stealth Rock support.</thought>

Garchomp
Dragonite
Rotom-Wash
Gholdengo
Annihilape
Tinkaton
</pokemon>
attempts.reasoning: Pick a strong BSS-style team: Garchomp, Dragonite, Rotom-Wash, Gholdengo, Annihilape, Tinkaton? Or Mimikyu. Go with Garchomp, Rotom-Wash, Gholdengo, Dragonite, Annihilape, Tinkaton.

attempts.answer:
<thought>The team is built around a bulky-offense core: Garchomp and Dragonite are setup sweepers with Scale Shot/Dragon Dance speed control, Rotom-Wash and Gholdengo provide defensive pivoting and status absorption, while Annihilape punishes passive play with Rage Fist and Tinkaton supplies hazards and Knock Off utility. Items are spread to cover weaknesses (Haban for Dragons, Lum for status, Sitrus for Annihilape's longevity) with no duplicates.</thought>

Build sets quickly. EVs: max 32 per stat, 66 total.

Garchomp: Swords Dance sweeper, Rough Skin, Yache? Give Haban Berry. Moves: Earthquake, Dragon Claw, Scale Shot, Swords Dance. Jolly 32 Atk/32 Spe.

Dragonite: Multiscale, Dragon Dance, Extreme Speed, Earthquake, Fire Punch/Outrage. Item: Lum Berry. Adamant.

Rotom-Wash: Levitate, Leftovers, Will-O-Wisp, Volt Switch, Hydro Pump, Pain Split. Bold 32 HP/32 Def.

Gholdengo: Good as Gold, Air Balloon not available — Wise Glasses or Metal Coat? Make It Rain, Shadow Ball, Recover, Nasty Plot. Item: Metal Coat? Use Wise Glasses. Timid 32 SpA/32 Spe.

Annihilape: Defiant, Leftovers taken — Sitrus Berry? Bulk Up, Rage Fist, Drain Punch, Taunt. Adamant 32 HP/32 Atk.

Tinkaton: Mold Breaker, Stealth Rock, Knock Off, Gigaton Hammer, Play Rough. Item: Rocky Helmet not available — use Shuca? Give it Assault Vest no... use Occa? Just give Muscle Band or Light Clay. Give it Light Clay? No screens. Give it Focus Sash? Better: Muscle Band. Adamant 32 HP/32 Atk.
